text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. This technology goes beyond simple word recognition; it focuses on text understanding, allowing machines to grasp meaning and context. For example, NLP powers online translation services, which can convert sentences from one language to another with reasonable accuracy. Another common use is sentiment analysis, where companies analyse customer reviews to determine if feedback is positive, negative, or neutral. NLP also drives chatbots, enabling them to answer questions, provide support, and have simple conversations. As NLP continues to improve, our interaction with technology will become much more natural and efficient.
